title: External instruction log promotes a compiled runner, then harvests incrementally

steps.command: graphflow task log "format lint and test billing package before release" --step "cd packages/billing-py && python3 -m compileall -q billing" --step "cd packages/billing-py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v"
steps.expect: Appends one JSON line to .graphflow/instruction-log.jsonl. Does not harvest.
First harvest records one use and does not compile. A second identical log line then promotes tasks.json and .graphflow/tasks/<id>.mjs. A harvest with no new bytes reads 0 entries.
After one more appended line, MCP harvest reads only the new bytes and advances .graphflow/task-harvest.json.

harvest_steps: cd packages/billing-py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
